spec.target: Next-season run value per 100 pitches (RV/100), MLB pitchers with 500+ pitches in both seasons
spec.decision_dates: season start (March 1 of the outcome season)
spec.group_by: none: a pitch-level model; pitcher identity is not a feature
spec.gate_decided: Matt, 2026-11-25: strict on the partial correlation with next-season RV/100 given Stuff+ (fit on the same fold): it must be above zero and so must the low end of its 90% interval. Pitching+ is Stuff+'s inputs plus location and count, so the gate asks what it knows that Stuff+ doesn't. Its edge over last season's results (Stuff+'s gate) and over Stuff+ are reported baselines and not part of the gate. Chosen with the development folds in view (baseball/pitch_quality/output/development_pitching_gates.json; outcomes 2024 and 2025, 324 and 311 pitchers, 2026 never read): partial r given Stuff+ +0.115 (90% interval +0.016 to +0.214) and +0.091 (+0.004 to +0.173), passing on both, narrowly. It is the only candidate gate that passed there: against last season's results +0.084 (-0.019 to +0.185) and +0.078 (-0.016 to +0.172); against Stuff+ +0.006 and -0.010; Stuff+ and Pitching+ combined against Stuff+ +0.019 (-0.007 to +0.048) and +0.012 (-0.017 to +0.042). A gate chosen knowing which one passes on the development folds is weaker evidence than one chosen blind; the 2026 fold was not read for the choice.
spec.prior_reads: The 2026 outcomes have been read by the registered tests of Stuff+ and Location+ (the same pitchers and target), and Location+ is this model's prediction minus the same model's without location. Pitching+'s own grade has not been scored against 2026 before this block.
spec.reproduction: Exact on the same machine; across machines tolerance ±0.01 in r (Matt, 2026-11-13). Official runs happen in CI.

vault.note: No sealed season yet: the only test season is 2026. The 2027 season becomes the vault when it completes.

entity_overlap.not_applicable: group_by: none: a pitch-level model; pitcher identity is not a feature

universe.note: entities without an outcome (retired, injured, too few pitches) can't be scored; they're counted here so survivorship is visible
